title: Digital Marketing Executive
description:
We are looking for a hands-on digital marketing executive to join a growing marketing function and take ownership of paid social activity across the group.

This role would suit someone who understands how to turn business objectives into effective paid campaigns that generate leads and drive conversions, rather than simply managing social media content. You will be responsible for planning, launching, optimising and reporting on paid social campaigns, with a particular emphasis on Meta advertising alongside LinkedIn and other relevant platforms.

This is a varied role combining creative thinking with analytical insight, giving you the opportunity to test new ideas, improve campaign performance and make a direct impact on business growth. There is also uncapped commission linked to lead generation and conversions.

Responsibilities:
As a digital marketing executive you will
- Plan, manage and optimise paid social campaigns, with a strong focus on Meta.
- Develop audience targeting strategies to generate leads and drive conversions.
- Manage campaign budgets and optimise spend to maximise performance and return on investment.
- Test and refine audiences, creative, messaging and placements to improve results.
- Collaborate with the wider marketing team to develop engaging ad copy and creative.
- Monitor and analyse key metrics, including cost per lead, conversion rates and return on ad spend.
- Set up conversion tracking and produce performance reports with recommendations for improvement.
- Work with internal stakeholders to understand business objectives and target audiences.
- Keep up to date with paid media trends and identify opportunities to improve campaign performance.

Requirements:
As a digital marketing executive, you will need
- Proven experience managing paid social campaigns, with strong hands-on experience using Meta Ads Manager.
- A good understanding of campaign targeting, optimisation and performance measurement.
- Experience managing paid media budgets and making data-led decisions.
- The ability to analyse campaign performance and turn data into actionable recommendations.
- Experience with A/B testing, audience segmentation and retargeting.
- An understanding of conversion tracking, lead generation and campaign analytics.
- Strong creative awareness, with an understanding of what makes paid advertising engaging and effective.
- A commercial mindset, with the ability to link marketing activity to leads, conversions and business results.

Benefits:
As a digital marketing executive you will get
- The opportunity to join a supportive group with a long history, operating across multiple sectors
- Uncapped commission linked to lead generation and conversions.
- Staff discount
- Career development opportunities.
- The opportunity to combine creative campaign development with data analysis and see the direct impact of your work on business performance.

If you're an experienced digital marketing executive looking for your next opportunity, we'd love to hear from you.

Rutherford Briant is passionate about equity, diversity, and inclusion. We seek individuals from the widest talent pool and encourage underrepresented talent to apply to vacancies with us. We are committed to recruitment processes that are fair for all, regardless of background and personal characteristics.

title: Marketing Executive
description:
We re looking for a proactive, versatile and commercially minded Marketing Executive to join a developing marketing team within a global, growing organisation. This is an exciting opportunity for someone who enjoys variety, embraces new challenges and wants to make a real difference to a business s marketing presence across Europe.

If you re a creative and organised marketing professional who enjoys variety, takes pride in delivering results and is ready to take the next step in your career, we d love to hear from you.

The successful candidate will have the opportunity to get involved in a broad range of marketing activities, including:
- Digital campaigns: Support the delivery of engaging campaigns across email, social media and online channels
- Website & content: Maintain website content and ensure messaging is accurate, relevant and engaging
- Creative communications: Produce compelling copy, newsletters, presentations and marketing materials for a variety of audiences
- Brand & PR: Contribute to communications and promotional activity that builds awareness and reinforces brand messaging
- Performance & insights: Monitor marketing activity, prepare regular reports and identify opportunities to improve results
- Project collaboration: Work with colleagues across the business to develop ideas and deliver effective marketing initiatives
- Events & promotions: Assist with the organisation and delivery of events, exhibitions and other promotional activities
- New ideas: Keep up to date with digital trends, tools and best practice, bringing fresh thinking to the team

Skills & Experience Required:
- Previous experience in a digital marketing or broader marketing role, with a good understanding of digital channels and marketing principles
- Strong written communication and copywriting skills, with an eye for detail and the ability to create clear, engaging content
- Excellent organisational and time-management skills, with the ability to juggle multiple projects, meet deadlines and manage competing priorities
- A proactive, hands-on approach, taking ownership of tasks and seeing projects through from idea to delivery
- Strong interpersonal skills and the confidence to build relationships with colleagues and stakeholders
- A commercial mindset, with an interest in understanding campaign performance and how marketing contributes to business growth
- Good IT skills and proficiency in Microsoft Office.
- Experience with Google Analytics or similar digital analytics tools would be advantageous, but isn t essential
- A full, valid UK driving licence (essential)

Benefits (Subject to Eligibility):
- A competitive salary package.
- Bonus opportunities.
- Enhanced pension contributions
- Healthcare and life assurance
- Enhanced annual leave
- A supportive, collaborative team environment
- The opportunity to work within a global, growing organisation
- Exposure to a varied mix of digital marketing, communications, PR, events and cross-functional projects
- The chance to make a tangible contribution to brand development and business success

title: Marketing Manager
description:
MARKETING MANAGER WICKFORD, ESSEX BASIC SALARY CIRCA £50k

What's the deal

At a time when many in the market are standing still, this family-run manufacturer is powering ahead. Turnover has more than doubled since we started working with them, driven by new products, five own brands and major investment across internal sales, field sales, and marketing.

Despite that growth, the business has kept everything that makes it special: exceptional people, down-to-earth leadership, quick decisions, and genuine trust. Now it needs a Marketing Manager to build on that momentum, raise the profile of its brands and play a key role in an exciting next chapter.

Your mission
- This is a hands-on role with room to think big. You'll set the direction, roll up your sleeves, and make sure great Ideas actually leave the whiteboard.
- Build and own a marketing plan that turns growth goals into campaigns people notice-and act on.
- Get close to customers, competitors, and market trends, turning insights into sharper positioning.
- Bring the brand to life across the website, social media, email, content, advertising, brochures, and sales tools.
- Plan and deliver launches, promotions, exhibitions, and trade campaigns from bright idea to brilliant execution.
- Work with sales, product teams, leaders, agencies, and suppliers so marketing is joined-up, useful and timely.
- Own the marketing calendar and budget, choosing the right channels instead of doing what's always been done.
- Track numbers, leads, engagement, conversion, revenue, and ROI-and use them to improve the next campaign.

The kind of person we're looking for
- Marketing Manager experience, ideally in B2 B, manufacturing, high volume construction products.
- Equal parts strategist and doer: shaping plans, writing briefs, and stepping in when deadlines need rescuing.
- A confident communicator who inspires enthusiasm and keeps everyone moving together.
- Creative, commercially minded, and curious about what makes customers tick.
- Comfortable with digital tools, campaign data, and budgets-you don't need to love spreadsheets but must understand them.
- Organised, proactive and low ego; comfortable with autonomy, collaboration and making a visible difference.

The Package
- Circa £50k basic
- 25 days' holiday + bank holidays
- Real autonomy, supportive leadership, and a role with genuine influence

Sound like your kind of move?

If you can turn a blank page into a campaign, a spreadsheet into a decision and 'we should probably market that' into something customers notice, we'd love to hear from you. This is your chance to shape the marketing function, make your mark and have some fun doing it.
